description: This file defines the 'JsonValue' interface, which represents a generic JSON value in the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides static factory methods for creating JSON literals and numbers, type-checking methods, and methods for converting to specific Java types. It also includes methods for retrieving the JSON value in object or array form and for serialization.

methods.name: nullLiteral
methods.description: Returns a JSON literal representing null using the JsonFactory.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Overloaded static methods to create JsonValue instances from boolean, int, long, double, or String.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Generic method to create a JsonValue from any Java object, using JsonFactory to determine the appropriate value.

methods.name: isBoolean
methods.description: Checks if this JSON value represents a boolean literal.

methods.name: isNumber
methods.description: Checks if this JSON value represents a number.

methods.name: isInt
methods.description: Checks if this JSON number can be interpreted as an int.

methods.name: isLong
methods.description: Checks if this JSON number can be interpreted as a long.

methods.name: isDouble
methods.description: Checks if this JSON number can be interpreted as a double.

methods.name: isString
methods.description: Checks if this JSON value is a string.

methods.name: isObject
methods.description: Checks if this JSON value is an object.

methods.name: isArray
methods.description: Checks if this JSON value is an array.

methods.name: isNull
methods.description: Checks if this JSON value is a null literal.

methods.name: asBoolean
methods.description: Returns this JSON value as a boolean. Throws if not boolean.

methods.name: asInt
methods.description: Returns this JSON value as an int. Throws if not representable.

methods.name: asLong
methods.description: Returns this JSON value as a long. Throws if not representable.

methods.name: asDouble
methods.description: Returns this JSON value as a double. Throws if not a number.

methods.name: asString
methods.description: Returns this JSON string as a Java String. Throws if not a string.

methods.name: asObject
methods.description: Returns this JSON value as a JsonObject. Throws if not an object.

methods.name: asArray
methods.description: Returns this JSON value as a JsonArray. Throws if not an array.

methods.name: formatAsString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the value, unquoting JSON strings.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Serializes this JSON value into the provided context, may throw IOException.

methods.name: getUpperBoundForStringSize
methods.description: Provides an upper bound estimate of the size of the serialized JSON string.
